scope_and_methods: Read all six pages of the official executive summary. It describes a 20,000-image dataset (10,000 spliced DIS100K images, 5,000 RAISE genuine images, 5,000 genuine crops from DIS100K); dynamic BLIP-Large captions for manipulated samples; zero/few-shot comparisons of LLaVA OneVision, Llama 3.2 Vision and DeepSeek-VL2; LoRA fine-tuning of LLaVA and a 1,000-image test set (summary reports accuracy .884, precision 1.000, recall .7618, F1 .8648). For caption/explanation assessment it compares generated text to custom reference captions with BLEU/ROUGE, all-MiniLM/NV-Embed similarity thresholds, and Llama-3.1-8B judge scores. The executive summary states the reference captions were dynamically generated with BLIP Large, but does not establish that they were independently human-validated forensic facts.
observed_reliability_evidence: There is an explicit multi-metric evaluation of natural-language descriptions. The LLM-judge scores are reported as accuracy .953, precision .9963, recall .9489 and F1 .9720; selected NV-Embed prompts report accuracy .962–.963 and F1 .9780–.9787. These are agreement/classification numbers within the proposed caption-judging setup, not demonstrated correctness of explanations against independent manipulation facts. The tested task is static-image splicing, not all forgery types.
limitations_and_construct_boundary: The six-page summary does not specify the source of binary good/bad labels used to calculate judge/embedding accuracy, independent annotator/expert calibration, inter-rater reliability, blind review, or whether tuning and evaluation sets are separated for threshold selection. Because manipulated-image reference captions were generated by BLIP Large and then used as ground-truth captions, semantic agreement may reproduce captioner assumptions rather than verify the actual edit. No localized edit-mask alignment, counterfactual edits, deletion/insertion faithfulness, parameter randomization, evidence sufficiency/necessity, hallucination/claim verification or human appropriate-reliance experiment is described in the summary. The main thesis body remains unread; these absences are limited to the inspected summary.
screening_conclusion: High-priority direct work because it combines image-splicing detection, free-form explanations and quantitative caption-quality evaluation. Treat its contribution as an evaluation framework candidate, not validated explanation reliability.
